backlog.spec: After featurizing train and test, compute on the training matrix a mask keeping columns with variance>0 and, for the Morgan count part, nonzero in at least 10 training molecules (descriptor columns always kept unless constant). backlog.spec: After fitting the ensemble and obtaining rank-averaged test predictions, take the test molecules with the most confident predictions (top 20% and bottom 20% by score) as pseudo-labeled 1/0, append them to the training set, refit all models, and return the final rank-averaged predictions. Transductive adaptation to unseen scaffolds; keep code compact via a helper function that fits and predicts.

backlog.title: Drop near-constant and duplicate features

backlog.spec: In featurize, before computing descriptors and fingerprints, parse each SMILES, keep the largest fragment with rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser(), then neutralize with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger(). backlog.spec: Append about 12 SMARTS match counts to the features in featurize: carboxylic acid, tetrazole, sulfonamide NH, phenol, aliphatic primary/secondary/tertiary amine, amidine/guanidine, quaternary N, pyridine-type N, quaternary or charged atoms, and basic-amine-plus-acid zwitterion flag. Note that the score is rank-based, so the top/bottom fraction is relative to the test set. Use a class-prior-aware cut if needed.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training on test molecules

backlog.spec: Set class_weight='balanced_subsample' for the RF, is_unbalance=True for LightGBM and auto_class_weights='Balanced' for CatBoost. Rank-average its predictions as a fourth equal-weight member.
backlog.title: Bold: Gaussian-process-like rank-transform target with CatBoost regressor ensemble

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, replace the single MLPClassifier on quantile-scaled descriptors with an average of 5 MLPClassifiers (seeds seed..seed+4, same architecture, early_stopping=True), averaging predict_proba before ranking. Keep it as one rank-averaged member. This reduces the variance of the MLP member.
backlog.title: Multi-seed MLP bagging

backlog.spec: Change the Tanimoto kNN member: use k=15 and weight neighbours by sim**3 instead of sim. Keep everything else unchanged. Sharper weights make the neighbour vote focus on close analogues.
backlog.title: kNN k and similarity power tuning

backlog.spec: Set class_weight='balanced_subsample' on the RandomForest, is_unbalance=True on LGBMClassifier, and auto_class_weights='Balanced' on CatBoostClassifier. Keep the MLP and kNN unchanged.
backlog.title: Balanced class weights in tree members

backlog.spec: After computing the initial ensemble rank-average on the test set, take the test molecules with the 15% highest and 15% lowest scores, add them to the training set with hard labels 1/0, refit the RF and LightGBM members only on the augmented set, and replace those two members' predictions with the refit ones before the final average. Use seed for all models.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training with test molecules

backlog.spec: For the tree members (RF, LightGBM, CatBoost), augment the training set with one extra copy of the training rows in which the descriptor columns are multiplied by (1+0.05*N(0,1)) noise drawn from a seed-based RNG, same labels, fingerprint columns unchanged. Predict on clean test features.
backlog.title: Descriptor Gaussian noise augmentation

backlog.spec: Replace the single radius-2 2048-bit Morgan count in the tree features with a concatenation of radius-1 (1024 bits) and radius-3 (3072 bits) count fingerprints. Compute the radius-2 binary bits separately for the Tanimoto kNN step so the nd-offset slicing still works.
backlog.title: Multi-scale Morgan counts r1 and r3

backlog.spec: For the MLP member only, drop descriptor columns with fewer than 5 distinct training values or absolute Pearson correlation above 0.95 with an earlier kept column, before the QuantileTransformer. Tree members keep all features.
backlog.title: Prune descriptors for the MLP

backlog.spec: Replace np.mean of the five rank predictions with np.average using fixed weights RF 1, LightGBM 1, CatBoost 1.5, kNN 1.5, MLP 2. No tuning inside the function.
backlog.title: Weighted blend favoring non-tree members

backlog.spec: Add a sixth rank-averaged member: KernelRidge(alpha=1.0, kernel='precomputed') fit on the min-max (count Tanimoto) kernel of Morgan count fingerprints with targets 2*y-1; predict with the test-vs-train kernel. Compute the min-max kernel in chunks of test rows with numpy to limit memory.
backlog.title: Bold: kernel ridge on count Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, replace np.mean(preds, axis=0) with a fixed weighted average of the rank predictions. Order is RF, LGBM, CatBoost, kNN, MLP. Use weights [0.15, 0.15, 0.25, 0.2, 0.25] so that the non-tree members get more weight. Do not tune the weights inside the fit.
backlog.title: Weighted blend favoring kNN and MLP

backlog.spec: Change the kNN member to use the top 5 neighbours instead of 10. Weight each neighbour by sim**3 instead of sim. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Tanimoto kNN with k=5 and squared similarity weights

backlog.spec: Change the MLPClassifier to hidden_layer_sizes=(512,128), alpha=0.1, and early_stopping with n_iter_no_change=20. Average the probabilities of 3 seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2) before ranking.
backlog.title: MLP with stronger regularization and wider layers

backlog.spec: Before fitting the MLP, build an augmented training set. Stack the quantile-scaled descriptor matrix Dq with 2 copies that have N(0,0.1) noise added, using rng = np.random.RandomState(seed). Stack y to match. Fit the MLP on the stacked set. Predict on the clean test set.
backlog.title: Descriptor Gaussian noise augmentation for MLP

backlog.spec: Set class_weight='balanced_subsample' on the RandomForest and auto_class_weights='Balanced' on the CatBoost. Set is_unbalance=True on the LightGBM. Keep the rest unchanged.
backlog.title: Balanced class weights in tree members

backlog.spec: For the MLP input only, drop descriptor columns that have zero variance on the training set. Also drop one of each pair of columns with absolute Pearson correlation above 0.95, computed on the quantile-scaled training descriptors. Apply the same column mask to the test set. Leave the tree models unchanged.
backlog.title: Descriptor pruning for MLP by correlation

backlog.spec: Add a member that uses a precomputed MinMax-Tanimoto kernel on the Morgan count fingerprints. Compute the train-train and test-train kernels. Fit KernelRidge(kernel='precomputed', alpha=1.0) on y*2-1. Rank the predictions and add them as a sixth member. Use pure numpy for the min/max sums in chunks.
backlog.title: Gaussian process classifier on Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Add a LogisticRegression(C=0.05, max_iter=2000) member on binary Morgan bits (X[:, nd:] > 0). Rank the predictions and add them to the average. This is a different inductive bias from the trees and the kNN.
backlog.title: Logistic regression on Morgan bits as a linear member

backlog.spec: Instead of the arithmetic mean of the rank predictions, blend them in logit space. Clip each rank prediction to [0.01, 0.99], take the logit, average across members, and return the average. This is a different aggregation that rewards confident agreement.
backlog.title: Rank-power geometric blend

backlog.spec: In the kNN member of fit_predict, change k from 10 to 7 and weight neighbours by sim**3 instead of sim. Keep everything else unchanged. Tests whether sharper local weighting helps on unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Tanimoto kNN k and power tuning

backlog.spec: Add a member: compute a min-max Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count vectors between train and train, and test and train. Fit kernel logistic regression approximation using a precomputed-kernel SVC(probability=False, C=1) decision_function replaced by a KernelRidge-free approach: use sklearn GaussianProcessClassifier is not kernel-precomputable, so instead run Platt-free LogisticRegression (C=10) on the rows of the training kernel matrix as features (empirical kernel map). Rank-average as sixth member.
backlog.title: Gaussian process classifier on Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Before the QuantileTransformer for the MLP, drop descriptor columns that are constant on the training set and, greedily, columns with absolute Pearson correlation >0.95 with an earlier kept column (computed on training data only). Apply the same column mask to test. Trees keep full features.
backlog.title: Prune correlated descriptors for the MLP

backlog.spec: Change MLP to hidden_layer_sizes=(512,128), alpha=0.1, and average predict_proba over 3 seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2), each trained on the same quantile-scaled descriptors. Rank-transform the average once.
backlog.title: Wider, more regularized MLP with 3-seed average

backlog.spec: Instead of the arithmetic mean of rank predictions, combine them as the mean of logit(clip(rank,0.01,0.99)) across members, and return that. Changes how confident extreme members are weighted in the ensemble.
backlog.title: Rank-power geometric blend

backlog.spec: Add a second MLP member: input is quantile-scaled descriptors concatenated with 64 components from TruncatedSVD (fit on training binary Morgan bits, random_state=seed) standardized. Use same MLP settings, rank-average it as a sixth member.
backlog.title: Bold: MLP on descriptors plus SVD of Morgan counts

backlog.spec: Add a member: 5 small CatBoostClassifiers (depth 5, 200 iterations, lr 0.08), each trained on a random 40% subset of descriptor columns only (subset drawn with np.random.RandomState(seed+i)), predictions averaged then ranked. Adds diverse descriptor-only boosters as a sixth member.
backlog.title: Bold: random-subspace descriptor CatBoost bag

backlog.spec: Keep the slot 51 setup: fit the MLP on quantile-scaled descriptors stacked with 2 Gaussian-noise (sd 0.1) copies of the training set. Train 3 MLPs with seeds seed, seed+1 and seed+2, and different noise draws. Average their predict_proba, then rank-transform the average as the single MLP member. This reduces MLP variance while keeping the augmentation.
backlog.title: Replicate noise-augmented MLP with 3 seeds

backlog.spec: In the Tanimoto kNN, use the top 5 neighbors instead of 10. Weight each neighbor's label by sim**3. Keep the rank transform and the rest of the ensemble unchanged.
backlog.title: kNN with k=5 and squared similarity weights

backlog.spec: Replace the arithmetic mean of the rank predictions with a mean in logit space. Clip each rank-normalized prediction to [0.01, 0.99], take log(p/(1-p)), average across members, and return the result. Rank values are already in (0,1], so only the final combination changes.
backlog.title: Geometric rank blend

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule. Give every training sample weight 1/sqrt(scaffold_count). Pass it as sample_weight to the RF, LightGBM, CatBoost and MLP-free members. This downweights over-represented scaffolds, which should fit the scaffold-split evaluation better.
backlog.title: Scaffold-diversity sample weights

backlog.spec: Add a member that uses a precomputed MinMax Tanimoto kernel on Morgan counts. Compute K = sum(min)/sum(max) between the training molecules. Fit kernel logistic regression (sklearn LogisticRegression on the kernel rows, C=1) or a GP-style kernel ridge on y*2-1 with alpha=0.5. Rank-transform its test scores and add it as a sixth member with equal weight.
backlog.title: Gaussian process classifier on Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Add a second MLP member. Its input is the quantile-scaled descriptors concatenated with the 256 most frequent binary Morgan bits, scaled by 0.5. Use hidden layers (256,64), alpha=0.05 and early stopping. Rank-average it as a sixth member.
backlog.title: MLP on descriptors plus pruned Morgan bits

backlog.spec: Add a CatBoostRegressor on descriptor columns only (depth 6, 500 iters, rsm 0.3). Its target is y smoothed by label-averaging with each training molecule's 5 nearest Tanimoto neighbors, excluding itself. Rank-average its test predictions as a sixth member.
backlog.title: Descriptor-only CatBoost with rank-target regression

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, remove stereochemistry from every molecule with Chem.RemoveStereochemistry. This makes features invariant to stereo duplicates, so the same molecule gets the same fingerprint and descriptors across folds. Apply it in featurize after standardization and before computing the fingerprint and descriptors.
backlog.title: SMOTE-free test-time augmentation via stereo-stripped SMILES

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, build test features not only from the canonical molecule but also from 5 molecules re-parsed from randomized atom-order SMILES (Chem.MolToSmiles(m, doRandom=True), with the numpy RNG or random seeded from seed). Count Morgan fingerprints and descriptors are mostly invariant, so use this only for the kNN and MLP members if they vary; otherwise skip. Average each member's predictions over the variants before rank-transforming. Keep training unchanged.
backlog.title: Test-time augmentation via randomized SMILES

backlog.spec: Replace np.mean of the rank-normalized member predictions with a geometric blend. Compute the mean of log(rank/len) over the members, which is the same as the geometric mean of the ranks. Return that. This rewards molecules that every member scores highly and penalizes disagreement. Keep all members unchanged.
backlog.title: Rank-power geometric blend

backlog.spec: Pass class_weight='balanced_subsample' to the RandomForest and class_weight='balanced' to LightGBM. Set auto_class_weights='Balanced' in CatBoost. Leave kNN and MLP unchanged. The aim is better ranking of the minority class, which AUROC rewards.
backlog.title: Class-balanced weights in all weighted members

backlog.spec: For the quantile-scaled descriptor MLP, augment the training set with 2 sets of mixup samples. Each draws random pairs of training rows i and j and lambda ~ Beta(0.4,0.4) from the seeded RNG. The features are lam*x_i+(1-lam)*x_j. The soft labels are thresholded into two stacked rows with sample weights lam and 1-lam, which keeps MLPClassifier usable. Average 3 seeds.
backlog.title: Mixup-augmented MLP

backlog.spec: Train each of the RF, LightGBM and CatBoost members on 5 bootstrap resamples drawn by Murcko scaffold group. Sample whole scaffold groups with replacement from the training set, using the seed. Average the predictions over the resamples before ranking. CatBoost uses 200 iterations per bag to stay within the time limit. This decorrelates the members and reduces overfitting to dominant scaffolds.
backlog.title: Scaffold-grouped bagging of tree members

backlog.spec: Add an MLP member trained as a multi-output regressor (MLPRegressor) on quantile-scaled descriptors. The targets are the label y plus 4 standardized auxiliary descriptors (TPSA, MolLogP, MolWt, NumHDonors), which are removed from the inputs for this member only. Use the first output as the score. Auxiliary tasks regularize the shared hidden layer. Rank-average it as a sixth member.
backlog.title: Multitask auxiliary targets from descriptors

backlog.spec: Replace the equal mean with weights of 0.5 for each of the RF, LGBM and CatBoost members (1.5 total, 0.5 each), 1.0 for the kNN and 1.5 for the MLP. Normalize by the total weight. Keep everything else identical. Test whether the diverse members deserve more of the blend.
backlog.title: Weighted blend favoring non-tree members

backlog.spec: Use a decaying learning rate in the boosters. In LightGBM, pass callbacks=[lgb.reset_parameter(learning_rate=lambda i: 0.1*0.5*(1+np.cos(np.pi*i/400))+0.005)] with n_estimators=400. For CatBoost keep the constant rate but add a second CatBoost with depth 5 and iterations 800 at learning_rate 0.03, averaging the two. Keep the rest unchanged.
backlog.title: Cosine-annealed learning-rate CatBoost and LightGBM

backlog.spec: Add a member that fits TruncatedSVD (32 components, random_state=seed) on binary Morgan bits from train only. Concatenate the components with quantile-scaled descriptors and fit a (128,32) MLPClassifier with alpha=0.1, then average 3 seeds. Add this as a sixth rank-averaged member, with the existing descriptor MLP unchanged.
backlog.title: Per-fold feature-subsampled MLP stack of Morgan SVD and descriptors

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, for the test set only, compute features from the standardized molecule and from 4 additional molecules re-written as randomized SMILES (Chem.MolToSmiles(m, doRandom=True) with RDKit random state seeded from seed, then reparsed). Descriptors are mostly invariant, but the Morgan counts and some descriptors can differ slightly. Average each model's predicted probability across the variants before rank-averaging. Training is unchanged.
backlog.title: Randomized-SMILES test-time augmentation

backlog.spec: Replace the noise-augmented MLP (or the current MLP) training data with mixup: from the quantile-scaled descriptor matrix, create 2x extra samples by taking random pairs (i,j) with lambda~Beta(0.4,0.4), mixing features linearly and using the soft label. MLPClassifier cannot take soft labels, so use MLPRegressor on the mixed target with logistic output replaced by rank of the output. Average 3 seeds and rank-average with the other members as now.
backlog.title: Mixup-augmented MLP on descriptors

backlog.spec: Change the final combination from the arithmetic mean of rank-normalized predictions to a mean of logit-transformed ranks: clip rank/len to [0.01,0.99], apply log(p/(1-p)), average across members and return the sigmoid of the result. This emphasizes confident agreement and penalizes members that strongly disagree.
backlog.title: Geometric rank blend

backlog.spec: Keep all five current members but weight the rank average: RF 1, LightGBM 1, CatBoost 1, kNN 1.5, MLP 2. Use np.average with these weights instead of the plain mean. This is a fixed hand-set weighting with no tuning.
backlog.title: Weighted blend favoring non-tree members

backlog.spec: Add a sixth member: quantile-scaled descriptors reduced to 30 PCA components (fit on the training data), then sklearn GaussianProcessClassifier with an RBF kernel (length-scale optimized, 1 restart, random_state=seed). Rank its predict_proba output and add it to the average.
backlog.title: Gaussian process classifier on descriptor PCA

backlog.spec: Train CatBoost in two stages. First fit 300 iterations at learning_rate 0.08. Then continue with init_model for 300 more iterations at learning_rate 0.02. This emulates a decayed learning-rate schedule. Rank-average the final model as the existing CatBoost member.
backlog.title: Cosine-decayed learning-rate CatBoost

backlog.spec: Add an out-of-fold kNN feature to the MLP input. For training molecules compute the Tanimoto-weighted kNN score (k=10) leaving out the molecule itself and its own scaffold group. For test molecules use the standard kNN score. Append this column to the quantile-scaled descriptors for a second MLP, 3 seeds, and add it as a sixth rank-averaged member.
backlog.title: Bold: MLP on descriptors with target-encoded Tanimoto kNN feature

backlog.spec: After fitting the tree ensemble, compute its out-of-bag-like predictions on the training set. Use the RF OOB probabilities (set oob_score=True and read oob_decision_function_). Train an MLPRegressor on the quantile-scaled descriptors with the target 0.5*y + 0.5*RF-OOB probability, 3 seeds. Use it in place of the current MLP's rank contribution.
backlog.title: Mean teacher distillation to MLP

backlog.spec: Replace the single RF with a bag of 5 RFs of 100 trees. Each uses the descriptors plus a random 50% subset of the Morgan columns, which is a new subset per bag, drawn with the seed. Average their probabilities and then rank them as the RF member. This adds random-subspace diversity at the fingerprint level.
backlog.title: Bold: Morgan count dropout bagged RF

backlog.spec: Keep the current train.py but make the MLP member a 3-seed average of MLPClassifiers (predict_proba averaged before ranking). Each is trained on quantile-scaled descriptors stacked with 2 Gaussian-noise (sd 0.1) copies of the training rows, with labels repeated. Use seeds seed, seed+1 and seed+2. This replicates slots 65 and 72, which looked consistently better, and adopts the change if it holds.
backlog.title: Replicate 3-seed noise-augmented MLP

backlog.spec: Replace np.mean(preds) with a weighted average of the ranks. The weights are RF 0.12, LightGBM 0.12, CatBoost 0.2, kNN 0.2 and MLP 0.36. They are fixed constants, with no tuning inside fit_predict. This tests whether the non-tree members deserve more weight than equal weighting gives them.
backlog.title: Weighted rank blend favoring non-tree members

backlog.spec: Combine the members' rank vectors by a geometric mean. Clip the ranks to at least 1/len(Xt), take the mean of log ranks and return exp of that mean. This penalizes molecules that any member scores low, and it replaces the arithmetic mean at the end of fit_predict.
backlog.title: Geometric rank blend

backlog.spec: For the test molecules, build 5 extra featurizations from randomized atom-order SMILES (Chem.MolToSmiles with doRandom=True, seeded via Chem.SetDefaultPickleProperties-free np.random seeding from seed). Add the original featurization. Predict with the tree members and the MLP on each version and average the probabilities before ranking. Descriptors and fingerprints are mostly order-invariant, so apply this only if it is cheap. Otherwise restrict it to a variant of the descriptors that depends on the conformer-free graph.
backlog.title: Randomized-SMILES test-time augmentation

backlog.spec: Change the kNN member so that when it scores each test molecule it uses the top 10 neighbors but down-weights neighbors that share one Murcko scaffold. A scaffold group contributes its mean label, weighted by its maximum similarity cubed. This reduces redundancy from near-duplicate series and matches the scaffold-split evaluation.
backlog.title: Tanimoto kNN with a scaffold-excluding vote

backlog.spec: Replace the single CatBoost with an average of two CatBoost models. One has 800 iterations at lr 0.03 and depth 5, with rsm 0.2 and random_strength 2. The other has the original settings. Both use bootstrap_type Bernoulli with subsample 0.7. Rank-average the two inside the CatBoost slot so that the ensemble still has 5 members.
backlog.title: Cosine-decayed CatBoost learning rate via staged refits

backlog.spec: Replace the RF member with 5 RFs of 100 trees each. Each RF is trained on descriptors plus a random 50% subset of the Morgan columns, chosen with np.random.RandomState(seed+i). Predictions are averaged before ranking. This decorrelates the trees through feature-view dropout.
backlog.title: Morgan count dropout bagged RF

backlog.spec: After fitting the MLP ensemble, soft-label the training molecules with the 3-seed average of its out-of-bag predictions. Train a final MLPRegressor on the quantile-scaled descriptors to predict 0.5*y + 0.5*teacher_prob. Use that regressor in place of the MLP member. This smooths noisy labels.
backlog.title: MLP on descriptors with mean-teacher distillation

backlog.spec: Add a sixth rank-averaged member. Take the quantile-scaled descriptors (normal output) and project them through 2000 random Fourier features of an RBF kernel (gamma=1/(2*nd), seeded by seed). Concatenate the same 256 PCA components of the Morgan bits. Fit LogisticRegression C=0.3 on the result. It is a different inductive bias from the trees and the MLP.
backlog.title: Wide random-feature kernel ensemble member

incumbent.description: Standardize molecules (largest fragment, neutralize) and add Tanimoto kNN and quantile-scaled MLP members to the rank-averaged ensemble.

memo:
Helped: the rank-average ensemble of RF, LightGBM and CatBoost (0.1361 to 0.0942). Molecule standardization (0.0899, 0.0904) also helped. So did the non-tree members, a Tanimoto kNN and a quantile-scaled MLP. Slot 39 combined these and is the incumbent (0.0859/0.0813, mean_adjusted 0.0836).

Did not help, or was within noise (sd about 0.0049): extra fingerprints, MACCS/EState, stacking, ExtraTrees/SVC/HGB members, tweaks to RF/CatBoost/LightGBM, kernel ridge, pseudo-labeling, scaffold weighting, class balancing, and multi-scale Morgan. Clear harm: physchem-only (0.1323), descriptors-only RF (0.1094), single CatBoost (0.1021), logistic blend (0.1079), XGBRanker (0.1034).

Best recent: noise-augmented MLPs, 0.0832 (slot 51), 0.0825 (slot 65) and 0.0822 (slot 72). Each is only 0.0004 to 0.0013 better than the incumbent, so all are inside the noise. Their consistency may still be real.

Next: replicate slot 72 or 65 once, and adopt it if it holds. Then try kNN k and the weights between tree and non-tree members. Avoid new fingerprints, stacking and tree members. Gains look saturated.
